crossRefs.note: The king said, “Whoever says anything to you, bring him to me, and he will not bother you any more.”

translations.web: The king said, “Whoever says anything to you, bring him to me, and he will not bother you any more.”
translations.bsb: “If anyone speaks to you,” said the king, “bring him to me, and he will not trouble you again!”
translations.kjv: And the king said, Whosoever saith ought unto thee, bring him to me, and he shall not touch thee any more.
translations.asv: And the king said, Whosoever saith aught unto thee, bring him to me, and he shall not touch thee any more.
